description_en: Copies a custom image from one region to another. Copying images enables cross-region deployment and replication of ECS instances
description_zh: 复制一个地域下的自定义镜像到其他地域。复制镜像可以实现跨地域部署ECS实例、跨地域复制ECS实例等目的
kebab_example: aliyun ecs copy-image --image-id m-bp1h46wfpjsjastc0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyImage

parameters.help_en: The name of the copied image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://. It can contain digits, periods (.), colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 复制后的镜像的名称。长度为2~128个字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，也不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。可以包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: destination_image_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the copied image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 复制后的镜像的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: destination_description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source custom image
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the source custom image. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 源自定义镜像的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination region
parameters.name: destination_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the copied image. Valid values:

true: Encrypts the image.
false: Does not encrypt the image.
Not specified: The encryption status depends on the backend logic. For more information, see the supplementary description below.

Default value: none
parameters.help_zh:
是否加密复制后的镜像。

true：加密。
false：不加密。
不指定：需要依赖后端判断，判断逻辑见下文的补充说明。

默认值：不指定
parameters.name: encrypted

parameters.help_en: The ID of the key used to encrypt the image
parameters.name: kms_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID of the image after replication. If you do not specify this parameter, the image after replication belongs to the default resource group.

If you invoke this operation as a Resource Access Management (RAM) user and leave ResourceGroupId empty, note that if the Resource Access Management (RAM) user does not have permissions on the default resource group, the operation returns the `Forbidden: User not authorized to operate on the specified resource` error. Update the Settings of ResourceGroupId to the ID of a resource group on which the Resource Access Management (RAM) user has permissions, or use the corresponding Alibaba Cloud account to grant the Resource Access Management (RAM) user permissions on the default resource group, and then invoke this operation again
parameters.help_zh:
复制后的镜像的资源组ID。如果不设置该参数值，复制后的镜像属于默认资源组。

如果您当前使用的是RAM用户调用该接口，且`ResourceGroupId`取值为空，您需要注意，当RAM用户没有默认资源组权限时，调用接口会返回报错信息`Forbidden: User not authorized to operate on the specified resource`。请您设置RAM用户支持的资源组ID或者通过相应阿里云账号为该RAM用户授予默认资源组权限后，再次调用该接口
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The key of tag N of the copied image. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. If you specify this parameter, it cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs:, and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 复制后的镜像的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of tag N of the copied image. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. If you specify this parameter, it can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with acs:, and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 复制后的镜像的标签值。N的取值范围为1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only perform a dry run for this request. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks whether your AccessKey pair is valid, whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user has authorization, and whether the required parameters are specified. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false: sends a Normal request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2XX HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

true：发送预检请求。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误信息。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 2XX HTTP状态码并直接操作资源。

默认值：false
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the copied image
